justification: Inspected the exact-package main classes under core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/: 23 classes totaling 2,373 LOC (e.g. small value types/exceptions like NotFoundException 39 LOC, WriterException 38 LOC, Dimension 62 LOC, ResultPointCallback 29 LOC, and enums like BarcodeFormat/DecodeHintType/EncodeHintType/ResultMetadataType). The only substantial orchestrators are MultiFormatReader (199 LOC) and MultiFormatWriter (105 LOC), and both mainly delegate to specialized readers/writers in subpackages rather than centralizing unrelated behavior. The package is a cohesive root API/support layer, not an excessively large or responsibility-concentrating god component.
